item_short_desc: Modeled after the classic field cap, Rothco's Adjustable Fatigue Cap meets rigorous standards and is designed with top-notch quality and performance. Crafted from a durable cotton-poly blend, this fatigue cap offers both comfort and longevity, making it ideal for a variety of outdoor activities. The adjustable hook & loop back closure ensures a secure and customizable fit, accommodating different head sizes with ease. The baseball cap's classic design and robust construction make it a versatile addition to any wardrobe.
